bundle.shortDescription: SHIFT — migrate running workloads between machines
bundle.longDescription: SHIFT checkpoints, transfers, and restores running Linux workloads between machines with verified integrity. The desktop client shows machines, workloads, live migrations, checkpoints, and history.
